integrity: Analytical proof and separate finite-tree numerical checks; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: One anomalous exponential vertex on the q-regular infinite tree, \(q\ge3\); one-shot nearest-neighbor exclusion; terminal one-point probabilities only. Prior published work covers homogeneous cavity laws; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Parity and sharp factorial screening of a single adsorption-rate defect on regular trees
